glosses: fee (monetary payment charged for professional services)
rate (amount measured in relation to another amount)

examples.text: Qual é a taxa de entrada?
"É preciso pagar uma taxa." "Que tipo de taxa?"
examples.en: "You need to pay a fee." "What kind of fee?"

examples.text: Eu aposto que as taxas não vão cair.
examples.en: I bet that the rates won't go down.

examples.text: As taxas estão prestes a aumentar.
examples.en: Fees are about to go up.

examples.text: O código de taxas é muito complexo.
examples.en: The tax code is too complex.
